name: Shulker Stuff
summary: Adds shulker box enchantments (Refill, Vacuum, Void), a Shulker Dyeing Station and a Netherite Plating upgrade for shulker boxes. Written by the pack author.

new_content.name: Shulker Dyeing Station
new_content.how_to_obtain: Craft (pattern DSD/BCB/BRB): dyes in the top corners, shulker shell top centre, polished blackstone in the sides and bottom corners, crafting table in the middle, brush bottom centre.
new_content.notes: Recolours shulker boxes with its own GUI.

new_content.name: Plated Shulker Upgrade (smithing template)
new_content.how_to_obtain: Duplicate: 7 diamonds around a netherite ingot with an existing template yields 2. A config option "Plated Shulker Upgrade Chance (1 in x)" suggests it is also found as loot; source not confirmed.

new_content.name: Refill
new_content.how_to_obtain: Enchanting table, treasure or trades per author readme
new_content.notes: Max level I; helps keep a stack topped up from the box contents.

new_content.name: Vacuum
new_content.notes: Max level II; pulls in nearby items.

new_content.name: Void
new_content.notes: Max level I; discards unwanted items.

mechanics.title: Netherite Plating
mechanics.description: At a smithing table, Plated Shulker Upgrade template + shulker box + netherite ingot gives a plated box (tooltip "Netherite Plated"), intended as a sturdier box.

mechanics.title: Data kept on break
mechanics.description: Shulker box loot tables are changed to copy name, contents, lock, loot, enchantments, dyed colour and plated state to the dropped item.

vanilla_changes.change: Dropped box keeps enchantments plus the mod's dyed_color and plated data in addition to vanilla components.

getting_started: Craft a Shulker Dyeing Station to recolour boxes; enchant a box for Vacuum or Refill.
editor_notes: Author readme says the config screen contains unrelated Miniblock Merchants options by mistake; ignore them. Exact enchantment obtain methods and effects unverified in-game.
